all.name: White Fox
all.description: Ami Han, the last of the legendary Kumiho, can summon her ancestral Nine-Tailed Power to fortify herself and heal her allies on the battlefield. As the calm and capable Director of Tiger Division, she is any team's unwavering backbone, no matter the foe.

item.name: Yeowoo Guseul
item.description: Fire a Fox Marble forward that bounces off terrain or heroes, then homes in on nearby heroes. It damages enemies, heals allies, and restores <Orange>Spirit Tail</> energy.

additional_fields.Damage: Direct hit: 40 per round; bounce hit: 25 per round
additional_fields.Healing_Amount: Direct hit: 50 per round; bounce hit: 35 per round

item.name: Spectral Surge
item.description: Consume one <Orange>Spirit Tail</> to send a spectral fox forward. It heals and grants <Buff>invulnerability</> to allies it passes through, damages and <Debuff>Charms</> enemies, forcing foes to move toward White Fox.

item.name: Fox Form Awakening
item.description: Enter <Orange>Awakened</> state, transforming <Orange>Spirit Tails</> into physical tails. While active, continuously drain <Orange>Spirit Tail</> energy and <Buff>heal</> nearby allies. Striking enemies provides additional area healing.

item.name: Claw Strike
item.description: While <Orange>Awakened</>, slash forward with a flurry of attacks.

item.name: Tail Sweep
item.description: While <Orange>Awakened</>, sweep forward tails to <Debuff>launch up</> hit enemies.

item.name: Predatory Pounce
item.description: While <Orange>Awakened</>, dash forward. Hit an enemy to <Debuff>Slow</> and flip over them, enabling a <Debuff>second dash</> that <Orange>knocks back</> enemies.

item.name: Spirit Sanctuary
item.description: Teleport to a chosen ally, instantly healing allies in the area while generating a shield.

item.name: Kumiho Unleashed
item.description: Manifest the full Nine-Tailed Fox form and <Buff>continuously heal</> nearby allies. Cannot receive healing effects from others while in this form.

item.name: Ninefold Slam
item.description: In <Orange>Kumiho Form</>, slam the ground, causing an explosive shockwave. Hitting enemies or summons grants One-Time Healing to self and nearby allies.

item.name: Blessed By The Nine
item.description: In <Orange>Kumiho Form</>, select an ally to grant <Buff>Continuous Healing</>, <Buff>Unstoppable</>, and <Buff>Lifesteal</> for a short time.

item.name: Kumiho Unleashed
item.description: Manifest the full Nine-Tailed Fox form and <Buff>continuously heal</> nearby allies. Cannot receive healing effects from others while in this form.
